description: Coastal water temperature — Current sea, bay and Great Lakes water temperature from the nearest NOAA CO-OPS stations: latest reading in F and C, observation time and age, 24-hour min/max/average and trend, and a swimming-comfort label. Pass place= (city or address) or lat=&lon=, or a NOAA station= id; optional limit= 1-5 stations (default 3) and max_miles= (default 150). Covers US coasts, the Great Lakes and US territories; inland points return 404 no_station_nearby. Price: $0.003 USDC (Base, via x402).
name: weather_water_temp
